Description

🍔 Get Ready to Run Your Own Fast-Food Restaurant in VR!

Welcome to Fast Food Simulator VR, where you step behind the counter and experience the excitement of running a fast-food restaurant in virtual reality!

Prepare tasty meals, assemble juicy burgers, fry crispy golden fries, and serve refreshing drinks to hungry customers. Take charge of your kitchen, manage orders, and put your cooking and multitasking skills to the test.
